text:
Situation: Vecuronium bromide is not on FDA's current shortage list as of 2026-10-21. FDA's history shows an earlier shortage first posted on 2020-05-06, since resolved. Current stock across Corvale East and Corvale General ranges from 7.5 to 26.6 days of supply depending on formulation and site.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1112832 at Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. ended 2019-12-13 and was classified OAI with 8 observations on the Form 483. That OAI classification occurred 145 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2020-05-06.

Our position: Supply is adequate for near-term needs. An approved P&T interchange exists for the same product from Gland Pharma Limited (NDC 68083013910), approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-01-27. Mylan Institutional LLC is the top-ranked purchase option and is not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue purchasing from Mylan Institutional LLC — approved by buyer.
2. Activate the approved interchange to Gland Pharma Limited product when Mylan supply is constrained — approved by pharmacist.
3. Monitor daily usage and days-on-hand at both campuses — approved by buyer.
4. Report any supply disruption to P&T committee within 24 hours — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: Initiate new vendor qualifications for Hikma, Meitheal, or Mullan at this time.
